the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The maximal open W with G_W to W having P exists with its characterizing properties by Descent, largest-open-of-the-base. The transport morphism G x_{U,t} R to R x_{s,U} G over R, (g, r) mapping to (r, r^{-1} composed with g composed with r), is an isomorphism (its inverse given by the same formula read backwards), so the base changes of G to U along t and along s are isomorphic over R. By the pullback characterization of the maximal open proved in the Descent lemma, the largest open of R over which the base change along t has P equals the largest open over which the base change along s has P; the former is t^{-1}(W) and the latter is s^{-1}(W), whence s^{-1}(W) = t^{-1}(W), i.e. W is R-invariant.
